The Magic Template SDK, also known as CutSame SDK, is a powerful and versatile tool designed to simplify and enhance the video editing process. Developed to cater to a wide range of video editing needs, this SDK offers a comprehensive suite of features that enable developers to integrate advanced video editing capabilities into their applications with ease.

<span id="b4a4be0a"></span>
# Prerequisites


* Ensure you have obtained a valid license.

* You have produced or purchased template materials and have obtained the material package.


<span id="5ff65245"></span>
# Environment configuration

For more information on configuring the project environment, you can refer to the two topics below.

<span id="0ccc6f72"></span>
## Development environment

For more information on the development environment required for Magic Template SDK, refer to [Development environment](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/video-editor-sdk/140-getting-started-with-ios#qnMWoIkOUU).

<span id="d2228ccb"></span>
## Project configuration

After getting the SDK, add it to your project dependency. If you are using Pod, add the following configuration to your Podfile (replace the version number with the correct one)

```Shell
pod 'EffectOneKit', '1.4.0', :source => 'https://github.com/volcengine/volcengine-spces' 
```


For more information, refer to the following: [iOS SDK Quick Start Guide](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/video-editor-sdk/140-ios-sdk-quick-start-guide).

<span id="5399fc2e"></span>
# API process overview

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

<span id="7190fba3"></span>
## Retrieve template list

The obtained data primarily consists of template information (template title, template preview video, etc.). It serves two main purposes: first, to provide data for page display information; second, to build the necessary data for subsequent template replay processes.

<span id="2778d829"></span>
## Retrieve template slot information

Subsequent **material selection** and **template replay** both require template slot information. This information includes material path and material type.

<span id="e5255556"></span>
## Fill template slot information

Fill the variable slots with custom materials, typically from photo album resources.

<span id="ff5dcf0b"></span>
## Material composition processing

Compose the template with custom resources into a single video, mainly includes the following processing:


* Compressing the materials to reduce resolution and improve replay efficiency.

* According to the template production rules, perform reverse playback processing of materials as needed.


<span id="48df9df2"></span>
## Template replay

Preview the video after composition.
